QUEST CENSUS DONE: 488 quest pages with {{Quest Header}} (Morrowind base 396, Tribunal 38, Bloodmoon 54).

RI-QST05 DEBT SETTLED (as far as UESP allows): base-game upper bound completable without a required kill = 264/396 = 66.7%; lower bound (also excluding quests routed through hostile-by-construction locations) = 223/396 = 56.3%. RI-QST05 claimed ~44% with honest range 35-45%. REAL IS ABOUT TWO THIRDS - the corpus UNDER-estimated Morrowind's pacifism by ~20 points.
Classifier hand-audited twice (30 + 22 quests), 5 then 3 errors found and fixed; residual ~5-10%, errors now bidirectional.

Per-faction quest PAGE counts (base game): House Redoran 36, Mages Guild 33, Fighters Guild 31, House Hlaalu 31, House Telvanni 29, Imperial Cult 25, Morag Tong 25, Main Quest 23, Thieves Guild 23, Tribunal Temple 23, Imperial Legion 19. RI-QST01's '~23 Thieves Guild quests' CONFIRMED exactly. RI-QST01's '20-30 per line' band is slightly narrow: real range 19-36.

Pacifist fraction varies hugely BY FACTION: Mages Guild 88%, Thieves Guild 87%, Tribunal Temple 87%, House Hlaalu 77%, House Telvanni 76%, Imperial Legion 68%, Main Quest 65%, House Redoran 64%, Imperial Cult 64%, Fighters Guild 32%, Vampire 29%, Daedric 29%, Morag Tong 24%. This is a design finding: Morrowind buys its pacifism by making whole LINES non-violent, not by giving every quest an alternative.

RI-QST07 CONTRADICTED: it derives ~139 side quests (~a third of 427). Real: base game 396 pages = 23 main + 275 faction = 298, leaving 98 non-faction/side pages = 24.7%, i.e. about a QUARTER not a third.

RI-QST08: 263 of 448 quests with a reward field (58.7%) name at least one item in the Reward. That is an UPPER bound on 'unique reward' fraction (some named items are common). RI-QST08's 40% floor is below Morrowind's figure.
Quest stages: median 4, mean 5.15, max 28 journal indices per quest page. Gold rewards: median 500, min 10, max 693,750 (Tribunal Museum aggregate).
Gating: 221/488 quests carry a ReqRank, 319 carry a Prev quest, 266 carry a reputation delta, 312 a disposition delta.
WORLD CENSUS DONE: 40 settlement pages. NPC pages resolved to a settlement: 1048 of 1429 NPC pages.

RI-WLD03 CHECK - Balmora: 85 named NPC pages (RI-WLD03 cites ~94; close, our count is NPC PAGES so ~10% low is expected). Vivec 187, Ald'ruhn 111, Mournhold 87, Ebonheart 56, Sadrith Mora 53, Gnisis 31, Caldera 29, Suran 26, Seyda Neen 25.

RI-WLD03 CONTRADICTED on trainers and shops. Its capital target is 5 skill trainers and 7 shops. Real Balmora: 39 NPCs offer training and 36 offer barter (of 85). Vivec: 46 trainers, 67 merchants. Morrowind's service NPCs are UBIQUITOUS, not scarce - a capital target of 5 trainers is an order of magnitude below Morrowind.

RI-WLD03's '2,824 NPCs on Vvardenfell' cannot be confirmed from the extract: the extract holds 1,429 NPC Summary pages total across Morrowind+Tribunal+Bloodmoon. UESP pages only named NPCs; 2,824 is presumably a Construction Set record count. Flag as unsettled.

Settlement services listed by UESP Town Table: median 3, max 9 (Balmora and Vivec). Balmora's 9: Alchemist, Blacksmith, Bookseller, Clothier, Enchanter, Pawnbroker, Tavern (3), Trader, Tribunal Temple.

Interiors with their own Place page: median 5 per settlement, max 15 (Balmora). UESP does not page every house, so this is a FLOOR not a total - RI-WLD03's 26-named-interiors capital target cannot be falsified from UESP.
BLACKMARSH CANON DONE: 194 places, 66 creatures, 471 NPCs, 25 factions/tribes, 147 lore facts (61 of them in-world books), 10 named plants.
CF-045 CONTRADICTED: Knahaten Flu ran 2E 560 to 2E 603 = 43 years (Lore:Knahaten Flu). Registry says 41 years to 2E 601.

CF-050 CORRECTED: prison is 'The Rose', raised in a SINGLE DAY by Pelladil Direnni summoning stone atronachs, commissioned by Akaviri Potentate Versidue-Shaie (registry misspells him 'Versidae-Shae'). Lilmothiit founded BOTH Lilmoth and Blackrose.
CF-047 CORRECTED: Kothringi = 'the Lustrous Folk', silver-skinned, indigenous, sailors - all confirmed; 'Nedic descent' NOT stated by the source. Some fled west on the Crimson Ship.

CF-046 CORRECTED: source hedges - Kothringi 'thought to be exterminated', Lilmothiit 'mostly extinct', Argonians 'appear immune'. Lore:On the Knahaten Flu records the accusation that Argonians introduced the flu in retaliation for Dunmer slaving, 'never proven or disproven' - usable and not in the registry.

CF-006 CONFIRMED + DEEPENED: Lore:Hist Sap documents ARGONIAN sap-poisoning with named progressive symptoms - 'gold tongue', 'bark scale', hallucinations (Miredancer Sap-Speakers). The corpus's constructed 5-band sap-taint CF-C011 has a real canonical ancestor. Also: a badly-treated Hist makes its sap bloodlust ARGONIANS too, so the effect is about the tree's condition not the drinker's race. Also 'Amber Plasm' = Chaotic Creatia leaking through a Hist 'like blood from a wound' - sits on top of constructed CF-C009 sapwell-as-wound.
CF-067 CONFIRMED: An-Xileel formed 'sometime during the Oblivion Crisis' - so absent in 3E 427.

CF-028/029 CONFIRMED verbatim + 3 additions: Shadowscales follow a DISTINCT set of Five Tenets; tenet-breaking is treason executed by the Argonian Royal Court via an unaffiliated assassin; the 'King of Black Marsh' role is explicitly said to be OVERSTATED with no such king thought to have ruled 'if at all'.

*** BIGGEST FINDING *** THE CORPUS'S OWN JEL VALIDATOR REJECTS CANON. Running corpus/80-methods/jel-phonotactics.py against the 30 attested Jel words gives a 26.7% violation rate against its own 5% threshold: RESULT FAIL. Rejected attested words: Saxhleel (the Argonians' own word for themselves, medial 'xhl'), Thtithil (egg - already cited as canon in CF-025, initial 'tht'), Xeech (seed - a root in our own lexicon, final 'ch'), Greel ('gr' banned as epic-fantasy cluster), Krona ('kr'), Norg (final 'rg'), Vakka (geminate 'kk'), Xthari ('xth').
SOURCE FOR ALL OF IT: Lore:The Sharper Tongue: A Jel Primer - a 24-entry in-world Jel glossary. 23 of its words are missing from jel-lexicon.json.

4 GLOSS CONTRADICTIONS in jel-lexicon.json vs the primer: xul = DEATH/rebirth (we have 'root, that which goes down' - so xul-aneekh 'Deep-Kin' actually reads 'Death-Kin'); uxith = NEST/HOME/BED (we have 'old, long-standing' AND mark it community-data, i.e. claim a source it does not have); ojel = OUTSIDER, 'not of Argonian tongue' (we have 'tongue, the organ'); kaal = WAR CAPTAIN (we coined it as 'to kneel'). CONFIRMED: beeko, deelith, vastei, lukiul, haj, xeech (canon xeech already carries the birth/potential metaphor we were going to have to invent).

RI-LOR04 naming grammar CONTRADICTED on shape: of 377 attested Argonian names, only 43 are Tamrielic-descriptive; 142 are Jel compounds (Am-Lai, Heem-La, Miun-Gei, Okan-Shei) and 182 single Jel words. The dominant real form is NOT the hyphenated English phrase. In Morrowind-era names specifically: 17 descriptive, 14 Jel compound, 9 single.
RI-LOR04 word-count rule CONTRADICTED: it says 2-4 words modal 3. Attested descriptive names run 2 (31), 3 (6), 4 (5), 5 (1 - Morning-Star-Steals-Away-Clouds). Modal is TWO, not three, and 5 exists.

RI-LOR04 misses a whole register: attested Argonian TITLE PREFIXES - Tree-Minder (9), Nisswo (7), Sun-Eater (7), Dead-Water (3), Grave-Singer (2), Raj-Kaal (2), Egg-Tender, Bond-Guru, Chime-Maker, Sap-Speaker, Ux-Deelith. Raj-Kaal independently confirms kaal=war captain and raj- as honorific (primer: Raj-Beeko).
Canon Morrowind name Skink-in-Tree's-Shade contains an APOSTROPHE and a lowercase 'in' - both against RI-LOR04's letter.
